description:
Damage sites for Flood, Ukraine, 6 June 2023 (FL20230606UKR): 684,690 features merged from 301 source layers. Point layers with a damage class column (such as `Main_Damage_Site_Class`): one point per assessed structure or site. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Cumulative Satellite Detected Waters and Impact over Khersonska Oblast in Ukraine between 06 and 09 June 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cumulative-waters-and-impact-over-khersonska-oblast-in-ukraine-between-06-and-09-june-2023)
- [Damage assessment around the Nova Kakhova Dam, Ukraine as of 06 June 2023; 08:07 UTC](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-around-the-nova-kakhova-dam-ukraine-as-of-06-june-2023-08-07-utc)
- [Damage assessment over Antonivka City and Dachi City, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-antonivka-city-and-dachi-city-khersonskyi-region-khersonska-oblast-)
- [Damage assessment over Kardashynka Village, Kokhany Village and surroundings, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-kardashynka-village-kokhany-village-and-surroundings-khersonskyi-re)
- [Damage assessment over Kherson City, Khersonskyi Region, Kehersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023; 08:19 UTC](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-kherson-city-khersonskyi-region-kehersonska-oblast-ukraine-as-of-07)
- [Damage assessment over Kherson City, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 17 June 2023.](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-kherson-city-khersonskyi-region-khersonska-oblast-ukraine-as-of-17-)
- [Damage assessment over Oleshky City, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-oleshky-city-khersonskyi-region-khersonska-oblast-ukraine-as-of-07-)
- [Damage assessment over Solontsi Village and Pidlisne Village, Khersonskyi Region, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 07 June 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-over-solontsi-village-and-pidlisne-village-khersonskyi-region-khersonska)
- [Flood water extent evolution over Oleshky City in the east bank of the Dnipro (Dnieper) in Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 09 June 2023; 08:37 UTC](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-water-extent-evolution-over-oleshky-city-in-the-east-bank-of-the-dnipro-dnieper-in-k)
- [Flood water extent over Hola Prystan City in the east bank of the Dnipro (Dnieper) in Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 17 June 2023; 09:13 UTC](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/flood-water-extent-over-hola-prystan-city-in-the-east-bank-of-the-dnipro-dnieper-in-kherso)
- [Floods along the Dnipro River, Ukraine - UNOSAT Live Web Map](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/floods-along-the-dnipro-river-ukraine-unosat-live-web-map)
- [Satellite Detected Waters Evolution over Khersonska, Dnipropetrovska, Mykolaivska,Odeska and Zaporizka Oblasts in Ukraine  as of 15 July 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/waters-evolution-over-khersonska-dnipropetrovska-mykolaivska-odeska-and-zaporizka-oblasts-)
- and 7 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SiteID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `SiteID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `SensorID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Destroyed; 2 = Severe Damage; 3 = Moderate Damage; 4 = Possible Damage; 5 = Impact Crater (Damage to Road); 6 = No Visible Damage; 7 = Impact Crater (Damage to Field); 8 = Destroyed (Demolition Zone); 9 = Suspected Phosphorus shell Attack Zone; 10 = Road Damage from Tank Passage; 11 = Possible Damage from adjacent impact, debris; 12 = Lava Flow; 13 = Damage. The decoded text is in `Main_Damage_Site_Class_label`.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `Grouped_Damage_Classes_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes_label
table:columns.description: `Grouped_Damage_Classes` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class_label
table:columns.description: `Main_Damage_Site_Class` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SiteID_label
table:columns.description: `SiteID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
